name: all fours squad stretch
instructions: Start on all fours with your hands and knees on the ground. Lower your hips back towards your heels, stretching your quads. Hold for a few seconds and return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: arms apart circular toe touch (male)
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and arms extended to the sides. Bend at the waist and touch your toes, making a circular motion. Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: assisted lying glutes stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with your knees bent and feet flat on the ground. Cross one ankle over the opposite knee and gently pull your leg towards your chest, stretching your glutes. Hold and repeat on the other side.

name: assisted lying gluteus and piriformis stretch
instructions: Lie on your back with one leg bent and the other crossed over it. Gently pull the bent leg towards your chest, stretching the gluteus and piriformis muscles. Hold and repeat on the other side.

name: assisted prone hamstring
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended. Have a partner gently lift one leg, keeping it straight, until a stretch is felt in the hamstring. Hold and repeat on the other leg.

name: assisted prone lying quads stretch
instructions: Lie face down with your legs extended. Have a partner gently bend one leg at the knee, bringing your heel towards your buttocks. Hold and repeat on the other leg.

name: assisted side lying adductor stretch
instructions: Lie on your side with your legs extended. Have a partner gently lift your top leg, keeping it straight, until a stretch is felt in the adductors. Hold and repeat on the other side.

name: backward jump
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart. Jump backward, landing softly on your feet. Bend your knees slightly to absorb the impact and repeat.

name: balance board
instructions: Stand on a balance board with your feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down, keeping your balance, and return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: band bent-over hip extension
instructions: Secure a resistance band around your ankles. Bend over at the waist with your hands on a stable surface. Extend one leg backward, keeping it straight, then return to the starting position. Repeat with the other leg.

name: band hip lift
instructions: Lie on your back with a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees. Bend your knees and place your feet flat on the ground. Lift your hips towards the ceiling, squeezing your glutes. Lower and repeat.

name: band lying hip internal rotation
instructions: Lie on your side with a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees. Bend your knees and keep your feet together. Lift your top knee, rotating your hip inward. Lower and repeat on the other side.

name: band one arm single leg split squat
instructions: Stand with a resistance band under one foot and hold the other end in one hand. Step back with the opposite leg into a split squat position. Lower your body until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, then return to the starting position. Repeat on the other side.

name: band pull through
instructions: Secure a resistance band to a low anchor point behind you. Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold the band between your legs. Hinge at the hips and pull the band through, squeezing your glutes. Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: band seated hip internal rotation
instructions: Sit on the ground with your legs extended and a resistance band around your ankles. Rotate one leg inward, keeping the other leg stationary. Return to the starting position and repeat on the other side.

name: band single leg split squat
instructions: Stand with a resistance band under one foot and hold the other end in both hands. Step back with the opposite leg into a split squat position. Lower your body until your front thigh is parallel to the ground, then return to the starting position. Repeat on the other side.

name: band squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a resistance band around your thighs, just above your knees. Lower your body into a squat position, then return to the starting position. Repeat.

name: band squat row
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and a resistance band under your feet. Hold the other end of the band in both hands. Lower your body into a squat position, then pull the band towards your chest in a rowing motion. Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: band step-up
instructions: Secure a resistance band under one foot and hold the other end in both hands. Step up onto a bench or platform with the opposite foot, lifting your body up. Lower and repeat on the other side.

name: band stiff leg deadlift
instructions: Stand with a resistance band under your feet and hold the other end in both hands. Keep your legs straight and hinge at the hips, lowering the band towards the ground. Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: band straight back stiff leg deadlift
instructions: Stand with a resistance band under your feet and hold the other end in both hands. Keep your back straight and hinge at the hips, lowering the band towards the ground. Return to the starting position and repeat.

name: barbell bench front squat
instructions: Stand with your feet shoulder-width apart and hold a barbell across your chest. Lower your body into a squat position, keeping your back straight and chest up. Return to the starting position and repeat.
